newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen flat, focus on Lautan Luas.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen flat, focus on Lautan Luas.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen flat on Monday as sentiment is seen remaining cautious due to continuing rupiah volatility, while the market is likely to focus on the debut of chemical firm Lautan Luas, brokers said.
"The index is likely to remain flat as sentiment is likely to stay cautious due to volatility of the rupiah," one broker with a large brokerage firm said.
Brokers said the market focus was likely to be on Lautan Luas which was scheduled to be listed on Monday.

"The counter is unlikely to stage a spectacular debut like what Maharani did last week, but we still expect it to make a modestly successful debut due to the firm's good fundamentals," one broker with a large local brokerage firm said.
Multifinance firm Maharani, controlled by President Suharto's daugther Siti Hadiati Prabowo, staged a strong debut last Wednesday, closing about 50 percent above its offer price of 600 rupiah.
The Jakarta composite index ended up 0.50 point, or 0.07 percent, at 724.00 points on Friday.
